name: concept-lab
description: Builds one page that teaches one concept, any field: a step-by-step walkthrough on one phone screen, or a watch-only animation. Each step highlights one thing and explains it in beginner words; Back/Next, no sliders by default, a few what-if cases at the end; warm dark look. Computed mode runs the real model; authored mode covers concepts with no model. Intent-lock gated; clinical facts from sourced reports only; each page is its own artifact.
